items.reason: Double-save never double-applies suggestions: acceptances persist at reported confidence; rejected items remembered per {noteId, version} and never re-suggested for the same version (LLM-WIKI-11).
Stale suggestions for a prior note version are discarded — never applied to newer content (version-stamp discard, LLM-WIKI-11).
When np_notes_llm_features autoTag/autoCategorize/autoSummary are off, no LLM call fires on save (test-asserted call-count = 0).
Toggling LLM features off mid-flight never crashes the save path (fire-and-forget, never throws).
Summary is optional: absent summary renders without a placeholder and NoteList secondary text degrades gracefully.
Filename sanitization contract: / \ : * ? " < > | → _ (SYNC-04); YAML frontmatter round-trips Unicode titles/segments.
Title collision → numeric suffix (My Note.md, My Note (1).md, …) by scanning existing files for highest suffix (SYNC-05); repeated sync of the same note is idempotent.
Rapid saves coalesce via the 50ms debounce (SYNC-03); external-change guard (2s tolerance, default Skip) protects user edits (SYNC-06).
Restore is additive + idempotent: id exists → update preserving updated if newer; id missing → create; local notes not in the folder are NEVER deleted (SYNC-09).
An interrupted restore leaves the notes DB consistent (no partial/corrupt note writes; preview counts before import).
